description: Refreshes to11 skills at session start and on every prompt.

hooks.command: if command -v to11 >/dev/null 2>&1; then to11 code --codex-session-start-hook; else echo "The to11 CLI is not installed, so to11 skills cannot be refreshed. The to11 install-cli skill installs it."; fi
if command -v to11 >/dev/null 2>&1; then to11 code --codex-prompt-submit-hook; fi
